before: The player starts with 3 Lives. When an enemy bullet hits the player, one Life is lost and the player receives a temporary 1-second invulnerability period.
after: The player starts with 3 Lives. When an enemy bullet hits the player, one Life is lost and the player receives a temporary 1.5-second invulnerability period.
The existing invulnerability period is not restarted or extended when a bullet overlaps the player during invulnerability.

before: - If the player is not invulnerable, remove the bullet, decrease Lives by 1, and start 1 second of invulnerability.
after: - If the player is not invulnerable, remove the bullet, decrease Lives by 1, and start 1.5 seconds of invulnerability.
A bullet absorbed during invulnerability does not restart or extend the current 1.5-second invulnerability period.

before: The game then resolves player bullet–enemy collisions and enemy bullet–player collisions. Defeated enemies are removed and award 10 points each. Valid enemy bullet hits reduce Lives according to the 1-second invulnerability rule.
after: The game then resolves player bullet–enemy collisions and enemy bullet–player collisions. Defeated enemies are removed and award 10 points each. Valid enemy bullet hits reduce Lives and start a 1.5-second invulnerability period.

before: The player begins with 3 Lives. A valid enemy bullet hit removes one Life and starts 1 second of invulnerability.
after: The player begins with 3 Lives. A valid enemy bullet hit removes one Life and starts 1.5 seconds of invulnerability.
During invulnerability, overlapping enemy bullets disappear without reducing Lives and without restarting or extending the existing invulnerability timer.
